headline: DeepSeek's flash model hits 13.1%, Google surges into top 3
summary: DeepSeek's v4-flash continues its climb, now at 13.1% token share and day 2 of an all-time high. Google's gemini-3.6-flash broke into the top 3 with a 2-rank jump and 8.3% share, also hitting a record. Four new models entered the rankings, while four older OpenAI and Moonshot variants dropped out.
highlights: google/gemini-3.6-flash-20260721 climbed to rank 3 with 8.3% share (day 2 of all-time high)
DeepSeek provider share now 24.6% (+0.6% today, +6.7% in 30 days)
Google provider share 13.6% (+1.3% today, +5.9% in 30 days)
New entrants: openai/gpt-5-mini-2025-08-07, poolside/laguna-xs-2.1-20260625:free, z-ai/glm-5-20260211, meta/muse-spark-1.1-20260709
